id: RuboCop::Cop::Style::NestedTernaryOperator registers an offense and corrects for a nested ternary operator expression

config.Description: Use one expression per branch in a ternary operator.

ruby_diagnostics.message: Ternary operators must not be nested. Prefer `if` or `else` constructs instead.

ruby_safe:
if a
b ? b1 : b2
else
a2
end
